# Loading HiC files

```{r}

### loading HiC files
HiCG <- read.delim("HiC_G.250000_compartments.cis.vecs.tsv", header = TRUE, sep = "\t")
HiCL <- read.delim("HiC_L.250000_compartments.cis.vecs.tsv", header = TRUE, sep = "\t")

### renaming columns before merging
{
  HiCG <- HiCG %>%
    dplyr::rename(
      weight_gill = weight,
      E1_gill = E1,
      E2_gill = E2,
      E3_gill = E3
    )

  HiCL <- HiCL %>%
    dplyr::rename(
      weight_liver = weight,
      E1_liver = E1,
      E2_liver = E2,
      E3_liver = E3
    )
}

### merging both Hi-C tables and add the 'Compartment' column based on the condition + switch status
hic <- HiCG %>%
  left_join(HiCL, by = c("chrom", "start", "end")) %>%
  mutate(
    comp_gill  = ifelse(E1_gill  > 0, "A", "B"),
    comp_liver = ifelse(E1_liver > 0, "A", "B"),
    switch_status = case_when(
      comp_gill == "A" & comp_liver == "A" ~ "A→A",
      comp_gill == "B" & comp_liver == "B" ~ "B→B",
      comp_gill == "A" & comp_liver == "B" ~ "A→B",
      comp_gill == "B" & comp_liver == "A" ~ "B→A",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

```

# Making a table with compartments and gene annotations

```{r}

### Chromosome mapping

### repare gene coordinates with chromosome info 

mapping_chr <- mapping %>%
  filter(is_chromosome) %>%
  mutate(chrom = paste0("chr", name)) %>%
  select(seqname, chrom)

gene_chr <- gene %>%
  left_join(mapping_chr, by = "seqname") %>%
  filter(!is.na(chrom)) %>%
  select(gene_id, chrom, start, end)

### Convert to GRanges

genes_gr <- GRanges(
  seqnames = gene_chr$chrom,
  ranges   = IRanges(gene_chr$start, gene_chr$end),
  gene_id  = gene_chr$gene_id
  )

hic_gr <- GRanges(
  seqnames = hic$chrom,
  ranges   = IRanges(hic$start, hic$end),
  E1_gill = hic$E1_gill,
  E2_gill = hic$E2_gill,
  E3_gill = hic$E3_gill,
  E1_liver = hic$E1_liver,
  E2_liver = hic$E2_liver,
  E3_liver = hic$E3_liver,
  comp_gill = hic$comp_gill,
  comp_liver = hic$comp_liver,
  switch_status = hic$switch_status 
)

### Find overlaps
hits <- findOverlaps(genes_gr, hic_gr)

library(dplyr)

bin_size <- 250000

# Compute gene midpoint
gene_comp <- gene_chr %>%
  mutate(
    gene_mid = floor((start + end) / 2),
    bin_start = floor(gene_mid / bin_size) * bin_size,
    bin_end   = bin_start + bin_size
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    hic,
    by = c("chrom" = "chrom", "bin_start" = "start", "bin_end" = "end")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    switch_status = case_when(
      is.na(comp_gill) | is.na(comp_liver) ~ NA_character_,
      comp_gill == "A" & comp_liver == "A" ~ "A→A",
      comp_gill == "B" & comp_liver == "B" ~ "B→B",
      comp_gill == "A" & comp_liver == "B" ~ "A→B",
      comp_gill == "B" & comp_liver == "A" ~ "B→A"
    )
  )
expr_ids <- unique(data$Ssal)
gene_comp_expr <- gene_comp %>% filter(gene_id %in% expr_ids)

### Gene × Hi-C overlap table 
genes_hic <- tibble(
  gene_id = mcols(genes_gr)$gene_id[queryHits(hits)],
  
  E1_gill = mcols(hic_gr)$E1_gill[subjectHits(hits)],
  E2_gill = mcols(hic_gr)$E2_gill[subjectHits(hits)],
  E3_gill = mcols(hic_gr)$E3_gill[subjectHits(hits)],
  
  E1_liver = mcols(hic_gr)$E1_liver[subjectHits(hits)],
  E2_liver = mcols(hic_gr)$E2_liver[subjectHits(hits)],
  E3_liver = mcols(hic_gr)$E3_liver[subjectHits(hits)],
  
  comp_gill  = mcols(hic_gr)$comp_gill[subjectHits(hits)],
  comp_liver = mcols(hic_gr)$comp_liver[subjectHits(hits)],
  switch_status = mcols(hic_gr)$switch_status[subjectHits(hits)]  
)


### Add gene coordinates to the overlap table
genes_hic_full <- genes_hic %>%
  left_join(gene_chr, by = "gene_id")

### Merge with your main data
final_table <- data %>%
  left_join(genes_hic_full, by = c("Ssal" = "gene_id"))

### Make chrom a factor for sorting 
chrom_levels <- paste0("chr", 1:29)
final_table$chrom <- factor(final_table$chrom, levels = chrom_levels, ordered = TRUE)

### Sort table
final_table <- final_table %>% arrange(chrom, start)

### Remove all fish species columns except Ssal
final_table <- final_table %>%
  select(
    -c(Okis:Drer) 
  )

```

```{r}

chrom_long <- compartments %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(comp_gill, comp_liver),
    names_to = "tissue",
    values_to = "compartment"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(compartment)) %>%              # Remove NAs for plotting
  mutate(
    chrom = factor(chrom, levels = paste0("chr", 1:29)),
    tissue = factor(tissue,
                    levels = c("comp_gill", "comp_liver"),
                    labels = c("Gill", "Liver"))
  )


chrom_counts <- chrom_long %>%
  group_by(chrom, tissue, compartment) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop")


cols_ab <- c("A" = "#BF2C34", "B" = "#799FCB")


plot_comp <- function(df, title_text) {
  ggplot(df,
         aes(x = chrom, y = n, fill = compartment)) +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
             width = 0.8,
             color = "grey20",
             linewidth = 0.2) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = cols_ab) +
    labs(
      title = title_text,
      x = "Chromosome",
      y = "Number of Compartments",
      fill = "Compartment"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7, angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
}

p_gill_genes <- chrom_counts %>%
  filter(tissue == "Gill") %>%
  plot_comp("Chromosome level A/B Distribution — Gill")

p_liver_genes <- chrom_counts %>%
  filter(tissue == "Liver") %>%
  plot_comp("Chromosome level A/B Distribution — Liver")


p_side_genes <- p_gill_genes / p_liver_genes

pn | p_side_genes

res1 <- (pn | (p_gill_genes / p_liver_genes)) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A") &
  theme(
    plot.tag = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    plot.tag.position = c(0, 1)
  )

res1


### Export plot
ggsave(

  plot = res1,
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(UpSetR)

# STEP 1: Keep duplicated genes and one row per gene
gene_comp <- final_table %>%
  filter(dup_type == "duplicate") %>%
  filter(!is.na(comp_gill), !is.na(comp_liver)) %>%
  group_by(Ssal) %>%
  summarise(
    comp_gill = first(comp_gill),
    comp_liver = first(comp_liver),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# STEP 2: Create TRUE/FALSE columns
gene_comp$A_gill  <- gene_comp$comp_gill  == "A"
gene_comp$B_gill  <- gene_comp$comp_gill  == "B"
gene_comp$A_liver <- gene_comp$comp_liver == "A"
gene_comp$B_liver <- gene_comp$comp_liver == "B"

# STEP 3: Keep only those columns and convert to numeric
upset_matrix <- data.frame(
  A_gill  = as.numeric(gene_comp$A_gill),
  B_gill  = as.numeric(gene_comp$B_gill),
  A_liver = as.numeric(gene_comp$A_liver),
  B_liver = as.numeric(gene_comp$B_liver)
)

# STEP 4: Plot
upset(
  upset_matrix,
  sets = c("A_gill", "B_gill", "A_liver", "B_liver"),
  order.by = "freq",
  mainbar.y.label = "Number of duplicated genes",
  sets.x.label = "Compartment-Tissue Combinations",
   text.scale = c(1.2, 1.2, 1, 1, 1, 1.6)
)
```

```{r}

## A/B Compartment Dashboard 
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(patchwork)


# Prep
tissue_colors <- c(
  gill = "#BF2C34",
  liver = "#799FCB"
)

# Compute compartment size in Mb
final_table <- final_table %>%
  mutate(size_Mb = (end - start) / 1e6)

# Reshape to long format for plotting
long_table <- final_table %>%
  dplyr::select(comp_gill, comp_liver, E1_gill, E1_liver) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = c(".value", "Tissue"),
    names_pattern = "(comp|E1)_(gill|liver)"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(comp) & !is.na(E1))  # remove NAs

# Add compartment type based on E1 sign
long_table <- long_table %>%
  mutate(Type = ifelse(E1 > 0, "A", "B"))

# Compute mean E1 per compartment for strength
strength_table <- long_table %>%
  group_by(Tissue, comp) %>%
  summarise(Mean_E1 = mean(E1, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Eigenvector loadings: distribution of E1
p_eigen <- ggplot(long_table, aes(x = comp, y = E1, fill = Tissue)) +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.7, position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(title = "Eigenvector Loadings (E1) per Compartment", y = "E1", x = "Compartment") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "tissue_colors") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

# Compartment strength: mean E1 per compartment
p_strength <- ggplot(strength_table, aes(x = comp, y = Mean_E1, fill = Tissue)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  labs(title = "Compartment Strength (Mean E1)", y = "Mean E1", x = "Compartment") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "tissue_colors") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "top")


# Reshape for plotting
size_long <- final_table %>%
  dplyr::select(comp_gill, comp_liver, size_Mb_gill = size_Mb, size_Mb_liver = size_Mb) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = c(".value", "Tissue"),
    names_pattern = "(comp|size_Mb)_(gill|liver)"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(comp) & !is.na(size_Mb))  # remove NAs

# Barplot of size
p_size <- ggplot(size_long, aes(x = comp, y = size_Mb, color = Tissue)) +
  geom_point(position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.2, dodge.width = 0.8), size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  labs(title = "Compartment Sizes (Mb)", x = "Compartment", y = "Size (Mb)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "tissue_color") +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

combined_plot <- p_eigen | p_strength | p_size
combined_plot
```

```{r}

############################################################
# 1) CLASSIFY PAIRS: A/A, B/B, and A/B same vs differnt comp ohno
############################################################

pairs_classified <- ohnolog_pairs_ens %>%
  # Annotate gene A
  left_join(final_genes %>% dplyr::select(Ssal, comp_gill, comp_liver),
            by = c("ensembl_A" = "Ssal")) %>%
  rename(gill_A = comp_gill, liver_A = comp_liver) %>%
  # Annotate gene B
  left_join(final_genes %>% dplyr::select(Ssal, comp_gill, comp_liver),
            by = c("ensembl_B" = "Ssal")) %>%
  rename(gill_B = comp_gill, liver_B = comp_liver) %>%
  # Only keep valid A/B calls
  filter(gill_A %in% c("A","B"),
         gill_B %in% c("A","B"),
         liver_A %in% c("A","B"),
         liver_B %in% c("A","B")) %>%
  mutate(
    pair_gill = case_when(
      gill_A == "A" & gill_B == "A" ~ "A/A (same)",
      gill_A == "B" & gill_B == "B" ~ "B/B (same)",
      TRUE                          ~ "A/B (different)"
    ),
    pair_liver = case_when(
      liver_A == "A" & liver_B == "A" ~ "A/A (same)",
      liver_A == "B" & liver_B == "B" ~ "B/B (same)",
      TRUE                            ~ "A/B (different)"
    )
  )

############################################################
# 2) COUNT PAIRS PER CATEGORY PER TISSUE
############################################################

# Gill
count_gill <- pairs_classified %>%
  count(tissue = "Gill", pair = pair_gill)

# Liver
count_liver <- pairs_classified %>%
  count(tissue = "Liver", pair = pair_liver)

pairs_counts <- bind_rows(count_gill, count_liver)

############################################################
# 3) PLOT (identical style to your example)
############################################################

ggplot(pairs_counts,
       aes(x = tissue, y = n, fill = pair)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge", width = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "A/A (same)"       = "#BF2C34",   # red
    "A/B (different)"  = "#9C6680",   # purple
    "B/B (same)"       = "#799FCB"    # blue
  )) +
  labs(
    title = "Ohnolog pairs: same vs different compartment",
    x = "Tissue",
    y = "Number of pairs",
    fill = "Pair type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

pairs_edges <- ohnolog_pairs_ens %>%
  transmute(
    gene1 = str_squish(ensembl_A),
    gene2 = str_squish(ensembl_B)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(gene1), !is.na(gene2), gene1 != gene2) %>%
  mutate(gmin = pmin(gene1, gene2),
         gmax = pmax(gene1, gene2)) %>%
  distinct(gmin, gmax) %>%
  rename(gene1 = gmin, gene2 = gmax)

pairs_1to1 <- pairs_edges %>%
  group_by(gene1) %>% filter(n() == 1) %>% ungroup() %>%
  group_by(gene2) %>% filter(n() == 1) %>% ungroup()

nrow(pairs_edges)   # all links
nrow(pairs_1to1)    # strict pairs




eve_dup <- final_table[
  final_table$dup_type == "duplicate",
  c("Ssal", "thetaShift", "isSig")
]

pairs_eve <- pairs_df

pairs_eve <- merge(
  pairs_eve,
  eve_dup,
  by.x = "gene1",
  by.y = "Ssal",
  all.x = TRUE
)
names(pairs_eve)[names(pairs_eve) == "thetaShift"] <- "theta_1"
names(pairs_eve)[names(pairs_eve) == "isSig"] <- "sig_1"

pairs_eve <- merge(
  pairs_eve,
  eve_dup,
  by.x = "gene2",
  by.y = "Ssal",
  all.x = TRUE
)
names(pairs_eve)[names(pairs_eve) == "thetaShift"] <- "theta_2"
names(pairs_eve)[names(pairs_eve) == "isSig"] <- "sig_2"

pairs_eve$theta_pair <- pmax(
  abs(pairs_eve$theta_1),
  abs(pairs_eve$theta_2),
  na.rm = TRUE
)

pairs_eve$sig_pair <- pairs_eve$sig_1 | pairs_eve$sig_2

pairs_eve$comp_gill <- ifelse(
  pairs_eve$comp_gill_1 == pairs_eve$comp_gill_2,
  "Same", "Different"
)

pairs_eve$comp_liver <- ifelse(
  pairs_eve$comp_liver_1 == pairs_eve$comp_liver_2,
  "Same", "Different"
)
plot_df <- rbind(
  data.frame(
    tissue = "Gill",
    comp_class = pairs_eve$comp_gill,
    theta = pairs_eve$theta_pair,
    sig = pairs_eve$sig_pair
  ),
  data.frame(
    tissue = "Liver",
    comp_class = pairs_eve$comp_liver,
    theta = pairs_eve$theta_pair,
    sig = pairs_eve$sig_pair
  )
)
```

```{r}
background_genes <- unique(ann$ensembl_gene_id)
background_genes <- intersect(background_genes, TERM2GENE$ensembl_gene_id)


############################################################
# 1. BUILD TERM2GENE AND TERM2NAME FROM YOUR ann
############################################################

library(clusterProfiler)
library(dplyr)
library(enrichplot)

ann_clean <- ann %>%
  filter(go_id != "", !is.na(go_id))

TERM2GENE <- ann_clean %>%
  dplyr::select(go_id, ensembl_gene_id) %>%
  distinct()

TERM2NAME <- ann_clean %>%
  dplyr::select(go_id, name_1006) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  dplyr::rename(Term = name_1006)

############################################################
# 2. TEST SET (ohnologs)
############################################################

test_genes <- unique(ohnolog_df$gene_id)
test_genes <- intersect(test_genes, TERM2GENE$ensembl_gene_id)

############################################################
# 3. BACKGROUND SET = ALL SALMON GENES WITH GO TERMS
############################################################

background_genes <- unique(ann_clean$ensembl_gene_id)
background_genes <- intersect(background_genes, TERM2GENE$ensembl_gene_id)

cat("Foreground:", length(test_genes), "\n")
cat("Background:", length(background_genes), "\n")

############################################################
# 4. RUN ENRICHMENT
############################################################

ego <- enricher(
  gene          = test_genes,
  universe      = background_genes,
  TERM2GENE     = TERM2GENE,
  TERM2NAME     = TERM2NAME,
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  pvalueCutoff  = 0.05,
  qvalueCutoff  = 0.2
)

############################################################
# 5. INSPECT & SAVE
############################################################

res <- as.data.frame(ego)
head(res, 20)

############################################################
# 6. PLOT
############################################################

if (!is.null(ego) && nrow(res) > 0) {
  dotplot(ego, showCategory = 20) +
    ggtitle("GO enrichment — ohnologs (BP)") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
} else {
  message("No enriched GO terms found.")
}

############ JIPPI KAYEYYYY - TID FOR A/B
############################################################
# FUNCTION: GO enrichment for ohnologs in a given compartment
############################################################

run_compartment_go <- function(final_genes, 
                               compartment_col,  # "comp_gill" or "comp_liver"
                               compartment_value, # "A" or "B"
                               TERM2GENE, TERM2NAME) {
  
  # Foreground = ohnologs specifically in A/B
  fg <- final_genes %>%
    filter(ohnolog_status == "ohnolog",
           !!sym(compartment_col) == compartment_value) %>%
    pull(Ssal) %>% unique()
  
  # Background = all annotated genes
  bg <- unique(TERM2GENE$ensembl_gene_id)
  
  # Keep only genes that exist in GO annotation
  fg_use <- intersect(fg, bg)
  bg_use <- bg
  
  message("=== ", compartment_col, " = ", compartment_value, " ===")
  message("Foreground (ohnologs): ", length(fg_use))
  
  if (length(fg_use) < 10) {
    warning("Too few genes — enrichment skipped.")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  enricher(
    gene          = fg_use,
    universe      = bg_use,
    TERM2GENE     = TERM2GENE,
    TERM2NAME     = TERM2NAME,
    pAdjustMethod = "BH",
    pvalueCutoff  = 0.05,
    qvalueCutoff  = 0.2,
    minGSSize     = 10
  )
}

# Gill
ego_gill_A  <- run_compartment_go(final_genes, "comp_gill",  "A", TERM2GENE, TERM2NAME)
ego_gill_B  <- run_compartment_go(final_genes, "comp_gill",  "B", TERM2GENE, TERM2NAME)

# Liver
ego_liver_A <- run_compartment_go(final_genes, "comp_liver", "A", TERM2GENE, TERM2NAME)
ego_liver_B <- run_compartment_go(final_genes, "comp_liver", "B", TERM2GENE, TERM2NAME)

library(enrichplot)

plot_comp <- function(ego, title) {
  if (!is.null(ego) && nrow(as.data.frame(ego)) > 0) {
    p <- dotplot(ego, showCategory = 15) +
      ggtitle(title) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
    print(p)
  } else {
    message("No enriched terms for: ", title)
  }
}

p1 <- plot_comp(ego_gill_A,  "Gill — Compartment A (ohnologs)")
p2 <- plot_comp(ego_gill_B,  "Gill — Compartment B (ohnologs)")
p3 <- plot_comp(ego_liver_A, "Liver — Compartment A (ohnologs)")
p4 <- plot_comp(ego_liver_B, "Liver — Compartment B (ohnologs)")

combined_AB <- (p1 | p2) / (p3 | p4)

combined_AB

########### SAME VS. DIFFERENT COMP IN PAIRS

library(dplyr)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(ggplot2)

############################################################
# 1) PREPARE SAME vs DIFFERENT GENE LISTS
############################################################

# SAME = pairs that are SAME in BOTH tissues
same_genes <- pairs_comp %>%
  filter(gill_pair_class == "Same" & liver_pair_class == "Same") %>%
  dplyr::select(ensembl_A, ensembl_B) %>%
  unlist() %>%
  unique()

# DIFFERENT = pairs that are DIFFERENT in AT LEAST one tissue
diff_genes <- pairs_comp %>%
  filter(gill_pair_class == "Different" | liver_pair_class == "Different") %>%
  dplyr::select(ensembl_A, ensembl_B) %>%
  unlist() %>%
  unique()

cat("SAME genes:", length(same_genes), "\n")
cat("DIFFERENT genes:", length(diff_genes), "\n")

############################################################
# 2) PREPARE TERM2GENE + TERM2NAME (your objects)
############################################################

ann_clean <- ann %>%
  filter(go_id != "", !is.na(go_id))

TERM2GENE <- ann_clean %>%
  dplyr::select(go_id, ensembl_gene_id) %>%
  distinct()

TERM2NAME <- ann_clean %>%
  dplyr::select(go_id, name_1006) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  rename(Term = name_1006)

bg <- unique(TERM2GENE$ensembl_gene_id)

############################################################
# 3) RUN ENRICHMENT FOR SAME + DIFFERENT
############################################################

ego_same <- enricher(
  gene = intersect(same_genes, bg),
  universe = bg,
  TERM2GENE = TERM2GENE,
  TERM2NAME = TERM2NAME,
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
  qvalueCutoff = 0.20,
  minGSSize = 10
)

ego_diff <- enricher(
  gene = intersect(diff_genes, bg),
  universe = bg,
  TERM2GENE = TERM2GENE,
  TERM2NAME = TERM2NAME,
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
  qvalueCutoff = 0.20,
  minGSSize = 10
)

res_same <- as.data.frame(ego_same)
res_diff <- as.data.frame(ego_diff)

############################################################
# 4) BARPLOT FUNCTION
############################################################

plot_go_bar <- function(res, title) {
  
  if (is.null(res) || nrow(res) == 0) {
    return(
      ggplot() +
        annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5, 
                 label = "No enriched terms",
                 size = 6) +
        theme_void() +
        ggtitle(title)
    )
  }
  
  df <- res %>%
    arrange(p.adjust) %>%
    slice(1:12) %>%
    mutate(Description = factor(Description, levels = rev(Description)))
  
  ggplot(df, aes(x = Description, y = GeneRatio, fill = p.adjust)) +
    geom_col() +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "red", high = "blue") +
    labs(title = title, x = "", y = "Gene Ratio", fill = "adj. p") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
}

############################################################
# 5) GENERATE THE TWO PLOTS
############################################################

p_same <- plot_go_bar(res_same,  "GO: SAME-compartment ohnolog pairs")
p_diff <- plot_go_bar(res_diff,  "GO: DIFFERENT-compartment ohnolog pairs")

p_same|p_diff
```
